name: Global Congress on Surgery & Anaesthesia
theme_primary: The Modern Operating Room: Innovation, Precision, and Patient Outcomes
theme_blurb: The Modern Operating Room: Innovation, Precision, and Patient Outcomes — from robotic technique to perioperative care, redefining operative medicine for 2027 and beyond.
hero_subtitle: An intimate two-day congress convening surgeons, anaesthesiologists and industry leaders advancing operative care.
about_heading: Where surgery meets the next decade.
about_lead: GCSA 2027 is a global forum for pioneering technique, perioperative research and cross-disciplinary dialogue across surgery and anaesthesia.
about_body: Across two days of keynotes, parallel technical tracks, video sessions and hands-on workshops, we convene the brightest minds to chart the frontier of operative medicine.
